title: Where each part runs
desc: An isometric scene in two parts. On your machine runs the plugin: the commands you type in Claude Code, the driver that runs the steps, and the instructions for each AI role. On GitHub runs one workflow: it locks the tests, and runs them again on every change. The plugin starts the workflow, and the workflow reports back.
